bullets.text: Russian DDoS Attacks Intensify - **NCSC** warns critical infrastructure is under threat from persistent cyberattacks.
LilaConnect's Rapid Migration - **LilaConnect** successfully migrated to **gaiia** in just 16 weeks, enhancing operational efficiency.
AI Chatbots Revolutionise Support - Telecoms are shifting to AI-powered chatbots for improved customer interactions.
Blue Origin's 6 Tbps Network - **TeraWave** aims to provide high-speed connectivity globally, targeting enterprise users.
Open Cosmos Launches Satellites - **Open Cosmos** begins its LEO constellation with two satellites for enhanced connectivity.
AI for Risk Management - **e&** partners with **IBM** to enhance governance and compliance using AI.
Wi-Fi 7's Promising Future - **Cisco** predicts 2026 as a pivotal year for widespread **Wi-Fi 7** adoption.
Semantic Layers Enhance Analytics - Telecoms are adopting semantic layers to streamline data analytics and insights.
Telenor Exits Thailand - **Telenor** sells its stake in **True Corporation** for $3.9 billion, focusing on fewer markets.
Liberty Global Eyes Three Ireland - **Liberty Global** in talks to acquire **Three Ireland** for up to €1.5 billion.
